title: Database coverage by zone, type and field
description: Counts how much of WoW: Forever's database is settled or confirmed, and which reported fields need more agreeing installs. The same counts and reported lists as https://everloot.app/database/coverage, as text, per zone, per type and per field, plus scoped totals and the current build's whole-fact settled-list size, separately dated and measured. Coverage = settled / expected, with confirmed / expected beside it; the denominator is max(expected, observed). Confirmed includes settled. Reported fields needing one or two more installs are counted without their values. A player-reported fact needs three agreeing installs to be public. Only public report identifiers and game-file facts are listed, never unconfirmed values, baseline rows, names or ids, or player names. Every answer states its scope, measurement method, data date and install counts; unknown values are [?]. Zone and type are optional; omitted filters cover all released zones and all types. Use it for how complete the database is for a zone or type; use the page tools for the facts themselves.

zone.description: Released UiMap zone id, such as 1429 for Elwynn Forest. Omit for all released zones.

type.description: Coverage type. Omit for all types.
